title: Does this promise include me? | Joel student study

pages.text: HOSEA & JOEL / NOVEMBER 16–22, 2026
Does this promise include me?
“I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh.” Joel 2:28
Start with this week’s official Come, Follow Me lesson
QUICK PATH • Four steps, about 8 minutes. Take longer if you need.
Begin with prayer. Read the scriptures, notice what they teach, and choose one small step. You do not need to share private experiences.
01 / READ & NOTICE · ABOUT 2 MINUTES
The promise includes young people.
READ Joel 2:28–29
Notice every group the Lord names. Why mention young people, women and men, and servants? Why not simply say “prophets”?
One reason I know this promise includes me is…
02 / CONNECT WITH CHRIST · ABOUT 2 MINUTES
Who pours out the Spirit?
At Pentecost, people heard the disciples speaking in languages they understood. Peter explained that Joel had spoken about this outpouring.
Who does Peter say poured out what the people were experiencing? The Holy Ghost is not just a powerful feeling. His help connects us with the living Jesus Christ.
How could knowing Jesus lives change how you face a difficulty this week?
HOSEA & JOEL / NOVEMBER 16–22, 2026
Quiet guidance. A small step.
Continue the quick path • You can stop after this page.
03 / BE PATIENT · ABOUT 2 MINUTES
What if it is not dramatic?
READ “Promptings of the Spirit” • Elder Gary E. Stevenson
Under “Some Words of Caution,” read only the short paragraph beginning “Spiritual matters cannot be forced.”
Could an experience matter even if it did not make you cry or feel overwhelming?
Guidance can come quietly. We cannot force inspiration to arrive on our schedule. You do not have to invent an experience. “I am still learning to recognize the Spirit” is an honest place to begin.
04 / TRY · ABOUT 2 MINUTES
Choose one small step.

• Read a few verses about Jesus and pause to consider what they teach.
• Pray about a real question and record what remains unclear.
• Act on a good invitation from scripture, such as including someone or making peace.
Check possible impressions against scripture and prophetic teaching. Do not assume every thought is a message from God.
This week, I could try…
Close with prayer. Bring one question or one thing you noticed to class. Keep anything personal private. Extra reading is optional.
